北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京风大天冷，出门添衣防风，注意保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is windy and cold. Dress warmly and protect yourself from the wind.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多云有点凉，风力不小，别忘了添衣哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and a bit cool, with some wind. Don't forget to add clothes.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云偏凉，体感 9℃，外出记得加件外套哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and cool, feels like 9℃. Remember to wear a jacket!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州天气舒适 22℃，多云适宜，享受好天气吧！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is a pleasant 22℃ and cloudy. Enjoy this lovely weather!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天 21℃，体感舒适，记得带伞以防万一哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is overcast at 21℃, feels comfortable. Carry an umbrella just in case.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有霾 12℃，出门记得戴口罩，注意呼吸道防护。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has haze at 12℃. Wear a mask when going out for respiratory protection.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京多云风力 3级，体感偏凉 8℃，出门多穿点！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy with a 3-级 wind, feels cooler at 8℃. Dress warmly!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天 11℃，湿度较高，记得带把伞哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast at 11℃ with high humidity. Remember to bring an umbrella.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有霾，气温 15℃，出门记得戴口罩，保护自己。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has haze, temperature 15℃. Remember to wear a mask when going out to protect yourself.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴冷体感 4℃，注意防寒保暖，别着凉了。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast and cold, feels like 4℃. Take care to keep warm and don't catch a cold.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阵雨 10℃，出门带伞，路面湿滑注意安全。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing has showers at 10℃. Bring an umbrella, and be careful of slippery roads.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 -22℃，极度寒冷！务必穿厚衣服防冻。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like -22℃, extremely cold! Be sure to wear thick clothes to prevent frostbite.
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -22℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴冷体感 -12℃，注意保暖，别冻着了哦！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is clear and cold, feels like -12℃. Keep warm, don't get frozen!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明风力 5级，体感 10℃，风大凉爽，记得添衣哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming has a 5-级 wind, feels like 10℃. It's windy and cool, remember to add clothes.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴朗 18℃，风力 4级体感凉，出门注意防风。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is clear at 18℃, a 4-级 wind makes it feel cool. Pay attention to wind protection when going out.
厦门.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云 7℃，体感 5℃，出门记得穿暖和点。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy at 7℃, feels like 5℃. Remember to dress warmly when going out.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连体感 -10℃，风力 5级。风大天冷，务必多穿！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian feels like -10℃, with a 5-级 wind. It's windy and cold, so dress very warmly!
